# Ironside Roofing & Slating

Glasgow's trusted roofers since 2009. Repairs, replacements, slating & tiling,
flat/EPDM roofing, chimney & leadwork, gutters/fascias/soffits, emergency &
storm-damage callout, and free drone roof surveys across Glasgow and central
Scotland. NFRC, CompetentRoofer, TrustMark, Which? Trusted Trader and
Checkatrade accredited. Fully insured, 12-month workmanship guarantee.
4.9★ from 300+ reviews, 2,400+ roofs completed.

## Services
- Roof repairs
- Full roof replacements
- Slating & tiling
- Flat & EPDM roofing
- Chimney & leadwork
- Gutters, fascias & soffits
- Emergency & storm-damage callout
- Free drone roof surveys

## Service areas
Glasgow East End, Glasgow Southside, East Dunbartonshire, North Lanarkshire.
